test_unicode_casting: test pybind11 unicode conversion for utf8, utf16, utf32, and wchar string roundtrips
test_single_char_casting: test pybind11 single char argument casting for char, char16, char32, and wchar types
test_integer_casting: test pybind11 integer casting for i32, i64, u32, and u64 with out-of-range rejection
test_tuple_casting: test pybind11 std::pair and std::tuple casting to and from Python tuples
